company.name: Bottomless
company.shortDescription: Bottomless is a coffee service that uses a smart scale to deliver roasted coffee based on users' consumption.
company.description: Developer of a WiFi connected scale designed to deliver fresh coffee at right time. The company's platform facilitates users to sync with the scale and leave the coffee bags as per their requirements, enabling individuals to get delivered freshly roasted coffee instead of stale coffee.

productsAndServices.description: A service that delivers freshly roasted coffee based on user consumption, using a smart scale to track usage and automatically reorder at the optimal time.
productsAndServices.name: Coffee Subscription Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables roasters and brands to offer automatic re-stocking of their products based on customer usage, integrated with their e-commerce platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Powered by Bottomless

productsAndServices.description: A beta service that delivers pet food based on consumption, using a smart scale to track usage and automatically reorder when needed.
productsAndServices.name: Pet Food Beta

productsAndServices.description: A closed beta program that allows customers to ship any product from any e-commerce site using Bottomless's existing hardware or custom prototypes.
productsAndServices.name: BYO Products

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $4,500,000, or 66.23% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,450,134 to $21,297,990, a 8.69x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Trade Coffee, Bean Box, Atlas Coffee Club.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
